question: Find a larger donor-resolved human liver cohort to test macrophage SEMA4D and HSC PLXNB2 with reduced processing confounding.
eligibility: More than six unique human liver donors, preferably at least five independent donors per relevant disease/control group.
Explicit donor metadata and author cell-type annotation or accessible validated compartment assignments.
One common processing pipeline/reference within the tested comparison; integrated multi-study embeddings alone do not demonstrate common raw processing.
Healthy/nonfibrotic versus documented fibrotic disease groups; no substitution of blood for liver or immune-only for HSC evidence.
Accessible data and legal reproducible retrieval within compute/disk budget.
No known overlap with GSE210077, GSE135251 or already-used development studies; unknown overlaps must be flagged.
ranking: Prioritize identifiability and common processing over total cell count or newer publication date. Record rejected/partially useful sources before viewing target effects.
fallback: If no qualified accessible cohort fits, publish the executed eligibility/data audit and exact blocker; no synthetic or pooled-cell substitute, no unqualified treatment claim.
